scientific_integrity: All four formulas are established analytically. The finite exact checks supplement, rather than replace, the universal proof; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly consistent paired-row square systems; Euclidean mean-square error from isotropic initialization, unit projections, four specified sampling policies. Asymptotic requires t^beta/N -> 0. This is not a universality assertion over all power-law spectral geometries.
title: Exact four-way Kaczmarz shuffling constants on a power-law family of paired rows
